title: The First Ripple
scene: Help that does not feel like comfort
together: The immediate misunderstanding lingers. An attempt at reassurance becomes another point of distance.
Brief memories of their three-year relationship will reveal earlier versions of this pattern. The specific memories are still to be written.
aarna: Being told to stay strong feels like being asked to put her grief away before anyone has understood it.
She feels unheard and begins to recognize that today's loneliness is not entirely new.
mukund: He is confused by the rejection of help he offered sincerely. The more she withdraws, the less capable he feels.
He remembers their relationship through the things he has tried to do for her, while struggling to understand what those actions have missed.
